The night is full of fright... and so are these skins! Dress the best for trick or treating with these outfits!

*1 Free Skin

items.description:
The anime teens are out this spooky season to care in scare!

*1 Free Skin

items.title: Furniture Store
items.creator: Project Moonboot
items.description:
Have you ever dreamed of a place to find plenty of new furniture to decorate your own home? Well, look no further than Furniture Store by Project Moonboot. 

- Includes custom furniture 
- Supercars 
- Modern city 
- Smart home features 
- Realistic textures 
- Custom food

items.title: Halloween Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Want to participate in Halloween night, but are missing a proper costume? This skin pack brings you the most popular and iconic monster costumes from pop culture! But not all of them are real monsters… can you find out who the imposters are?

+ Halloween
+ Scary
+ Creepy
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Stylish Teens 2022
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Are you a unique and stylish teen? Do you want to show your personality in the game? Well, then this skin pack is a perfect fit for you. Select your best match and join the game with friends!

+ Anime
+ Fashion
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Zombie Apocalypse 3
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
A great addition for a series of zombie apocalypse-themed skin packs by In Mine. This time we present you evolved and mutated zombies for you to play as. Few survivors included, but let's be honest who really can hide from these monsters?

+ Monsters
+ Zombies
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Magical Woods
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Discover and live in Magical Woods, a magnificent city formed by giant mushrooms! Explore your surroundings and live in this colorful and fascinating world. Choose a mushroom and make it your home!
- 5 skins

items.title: Private Millionaire Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
It’s a dream come true! Explore this private island and live luxuriously in a mansion worth millions! Play basketball with friends or relax by the beachside on this beautiful island! 

+ Mansion with swimming pool, basketball court, and more!
+ Hidden chests around the map
+ Perfect for roleplaying with friends
+ Built by Xenon Design

items.title: Mini Bed Wars
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Bed Wars is the fun PVP game where you must protect your bed, whilst trying to eliminate your opponents on islands in the sky. You're free to respawn while your bed is safe.

Buy items on your island to get a leg up on your competition, and protect your bed!

+ 8 Maps
+ Custom Rules
+ Team Select
+ Fast-paced mini islands!

*Multiplayer only map

items.title: Halloween Anime
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Life in an anime is just amazing! Dress up as your favorite characters at a Halloween party.

+ 12 skins (2 free!)
+ by Street Studios

items.title: Speedrunners
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Go as fast as you can and set new records! Go past your limit and work hard to reach your goals. Compete with friends to see who is the speediest. Look great while doing so with these stylish, modern outfits!

+ 10 unique, fashionable skins
+ Perfect for kids and teens
+ Designed by Xenon Design

items.title: Luxury Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description: Luxury is what the rich teens wear. Stroll the city streets in modern designer clothes. Don't just walk into a mansion, look the part of being rich and role-play as your favorite famous teen!

items.title: We Be Stylin'
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
These styles are in! New drip coming to town. Catch these fresh fits soon before your friends do! 

+ 13 roleplay skins!
+ Stylish attire inspired by fashion!

items.title: Halloween Demons
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description: It's Halloween and the demons are coming out to play. What will you pick? Trick or Treat! Things are getting spooky as the night draws in so get changed into your new Halloween demon skin and prepare to be the scariest in your friend group!

items.title: Ghosty Souls

The lonely souls are roaming the streets to feed on humans. Beware! 

- 19 spooky skins
- by DUH

items.title: Dream World
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Like being secretive? Give yourself a mystic element and dive into our masked Dream World!
Choose your favorite appearance; A masked anime protagonist or an office manager?

+ 2 FREE SKINS!!!
+ 10 additional skins to add to your collection!
- By ShapeStudio in partnership with G2Crafted

items.title: Skycup
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Wow, it's spinning! Try to get to the other flying cups! Will you take the magical path or create your own bridge? Find the portal to the End and go face the Ender Dragon!

- Flying cups
- A Skyblock adventure
- 5 different islands
- By Pixelusion & SeaStory

items.title: Halloween Disguises
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Trick or treat this Halloween in these spooky costumes! Be the envy of the neighborhood from any of these absolutely scary costumes!

items.title: Zombie Teens HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Over take the world with your own personal horde of Zombies! Quench the hunger for brains and shamble across the world of Minecraft with these undead skins!

items.title: Hacker vs Server Admin
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Choose a path: hacker or server admin and enjoy a unique experience! Try out all the crazy tools at the hacker’s house. Be in total control in the server admin’s house. Explore secret basements to find vaults and special mining areas or play a game of mini golf outside!

=> Search for enchanted weapons!
=> Trade for incredible items!
=> Perfect for role-play with friends

items.title: Fall Season
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The fall season is here! Take your coziest hoodies out of your wardrobe and style them with different colors. Shading is everything this season is about, so try to stay on pace with the news! Get in shape, start new hobbies or relax while watching the rainy season standing by the fire. 

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Hacker Mobs

items.description:
These hacker mobs just went viral! Equip these cool mob skins for a cool glowing gamer look.
